title: Downtown Delight - 5 Mins to Broadway
description:
**Beautiful home featured on Netflix's - Buy My House!**
 
Only 5 miles to Downtown, Broadway, Top Golf, Nissan Stadium and more! A great place to enjoy with family or friends!

The space
Enjoy your time in The Music City with your group of friends or family by spreading out in our spacious new-construction home.  Just moments from downtown, this home is the perfect place to get ready for your night out on Broadway, or to relax as a group while using our ample open-space social area and fully equipped kitchen. We have generous sleeping arrangements or cozy up on the couch to watch your favorite show. Our home is close to restaurants, nightlife, shopping, parks and much more.

Other features:
Washer and dryer 
Excellent wireless internet
Cable TV with Netflix
Memory foam mattresses
Extra pillows and blankets
Comfortable linens
Cotton bath towels
Hair dryers
Shampoo and body wash
2-car garage

***please note: this home has 3 flights of stairs to reach 2 of the 3 bedrooms. Those with very limited mobility may want to consider this before booking***

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home, including the garage!

Other things to note
Please note this is a 3 story home, not including the rooftop deck. Those uncomfortable with stairs may not be a fit for our home!
